_comment: Pins 637343f (Report upstream token usage instead of silently billing zero). The gateway always streams upstream, and an OpenAI-compatible server (vLLM, llama.cpp) sends no usage at all on a stream unless stream_options.include_usage is set. The field appeared nowhere, so every turn through a Chat Completions upstream billed input=0 output=0. A streaming Anthropic request translated to Chat must ask for usage.
